title: Tourbillion publish wiring and control cleanup
content:
Tourbillion got a small but useful cleanup pass focused on day-to-day control and release workflow.

What changed:

  • Added a fullscreen toggle beside the settings trigger so the screensaver surface can be expanded without relying on browser chrome.
  • Removed the bottom-center overlay elements and trimmed the mode picker to the three active options, while leaving the other mode code in place for later use.
  • Wired Tourbillion into the JeffersonWM ASO publish flow with publish:tourbillion, publish:tourb, and inclusion in publish:all, while keeping the existing buildlog and version-history commands.

This keeps Tourbillion lighter on screen and easier to publish from the shared JeffersonWM workflow.
